question: Should this PR land with the additive requestedProviderIds resolver contract and enabled @openclaw/voice-call streaming-config precedence?
rationale: The implementation appears correct for the reported bug, but it deliberately changes shared provider discovery and persisted Voice Call config precedence, which are compatibility-sensitive choices.

options.title: Land with compatibility acceptance
options.body: Accept the additive resolver contract and scoped streaming precedence because the PR has focused regression coverage and real Gateway before/after proof.

options.title: Narrow scoped config behavior first
options.body: Require a smaller pre-merge change if scoped Voice Call runtime config should only take effect after a doctor/update migration or explicit canonical-entry policy.

options.title: Pause for migration-only design
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers want scoped Voice Call config handled only through migration rather than runtime precedence.

recommendation.title: Land with compatibility acceptance
recommendation.body: Accept the additive resolver contract and scoped streaming precedence because the PR has focused regression coverage and real Gateway before/after proof.
